name: ch.signetex/register
title: Signetex
description: Public register of claims and forecasts with E0-E4 evidence grades and outcomes; no verdicts.

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Search the Signetex register of verified claims (public pages and MCP-only entries) across machine-intelligence, human-impact, politics-economy and corporate-promises. Internal or paywalled corporate entries are not included, nor are the speculative Futures essays. Returns matching entries with canonical URLs. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

query.description: Free-text search over English and German claim text, verbatim quote, speaker, organisation, company, ticker, topic and ID. Several words are matched individually (case and accents ignored) and results are ranked; common names and abbreviations are understood, for example SNB, Fed/FOMC, ECB/EZB, IMF, Take-Two/TTWO, GTA 6, Nvidia/NVDA, Altman. Optional if filters are set.

area.description: Register area: machine-intelligence (the AI itself), human-impact (AI and humans) politics-economy (forecasts by governments, central banks, politicians and economists) or corporate-promises (company and CEO statements).

kind.description: Entry kind: finding, forecast or possibility (also accepts the stored values befund, prognose, moeglichkeit).

grade.description: Evidence grade: E0, E1, E2, E3 or E4.

outcome.description: Forecast outcome: open, met, partial, not_met, unclear (German stored values also accepted).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Get one register entry by its stable ID (for example SGX-AI-000031 or SGX-HU-000016), including sources, counter-evidence, grade rationale and history, with the canonical page URL. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

id.description: Stable Signetex entry ID, for example SGX-AI-000031.

tools.name: due_forecasts
tools.description: List register forecasts whose due date falls within the given number of days (including those already due and still open). Futures essays are not included. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

within_days.description: Include forecasts due on or before today plus this many days (default 365, max 3650). Already-due open forecasts are included.

tools.name: register_stats
tools.description: Headline counts for the published register: totals, areas, grades, forecast outcomes. A hit rate is only included once at least 30 forecasts have closed, as on the public site. Only forecasts whose criterion was fixed before the outcome count; back-captured entries with criterion_timing retrospective are reported separately as retrospective_accuracy, never as a hit rate. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

tools.name: evidence_grades
tools.description: Return the published E0–E4 evidence-grade definitions from the Signetex method page, not a true/false scale.

tools.name: latest_proof
tools.description: Return the latest published OpenTimestamps proof snapshot of the register (root hash, status, manifest URLs).

tools.name: track_record
tools.description: Return the closed-forecast record of a speaker or institution: counts of met, partial and not met, and a hit rate per register area. Hit rates count only forecasts whose criterion was fixed before the outcome; retrospective (back-captured) entries are counted separately under retrospective. Uses public and MCP-only entries, never internal ones. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

speaker.description: Name of the person or official speaker to match (case- and accent-insensitive; partial names, surnames and common short forms allowed, for example Altman or Powell).

institution.description: Name of the institution or organisation to match (case- and accent-insensitive, partial match allowed; common abbreviations understood, for example SNB, Fed/FOMC, ECB/EZB, IMF, TTWO, NVDA). Alias: organisation.

tools.name: list_due
tools.description: List forecasts whose due date falls in the inclusive window from…to (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns public and MCP-only entries, including already closed ones in that window. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

from.description: Start of the due-date window, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: End of the due-date window, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: compare_forecasts
tools.description: Show forecasts by different sources on one topic, drawn from public and MCP-only entries. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

topic.description: Topic or free-text query, for example inflation, GDP, AGI, deliveries, or several words such as "SNB inflation" (matched word by word, ranked).

limit.description: Maximum number of forecasts to return (default 20, max 50).
